sections.title: But what is a neural network?

data.title: But what is a neural network? — 3Blue1Brown

transcript.text: Imagine the digit three written at low resolution.
transcript.speaker: Grant

transcript.text: Your visual cortex parses these pixels into the abstract idea of three.
What we'll do is build up a network that can take pixel inputs and decide which digit it represents.
Each neuron holds a number called its activation, between zero and one.
And the connections between layers carry weights and biases.
